svg.title: pi-speed footer at runtime
svg.desc: The pi footer in a dark terminal: the path line ~/Desktop/pi-speed (main), then dim stats "↑47k ↓6.4k R179k CH84.5% $0.023 42.3t/s 1.24s 5.8%/1.0M (auto)" on the left and "deepseek-flash • max" on the right.
